sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:29966
Court No. - 19
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 4152 of 2024

Applicant :- Ajeet Kumar Gupta @ Ajeet Gupta
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru.

Counsel for Applicant :- Vivek Kumar Shukla
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.

Heard Sri Vivek Kumar Shukla, the learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Anant Pratap Singh, the
learned Aga for the State and perused the records.

2.  The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicants on bail in Case Crime No.
366 of 2020, under Sections 406, 419, 420, 467, 468 & 471 IPC, Police Station Kotwali Rudauli,
District Faizabad/Ayodhya.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 22.03.2020 against five persons, including the applicant stating that the informant had made investment in Eye Vision India Credit Cooperative Society Limited Anee Bullion Traders; but upon maturity no amount was paid to him.

entities.text: Eye Vision India Credit Cooperative Society Limited Anee Bullion Traders
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Applicant's criminal history of 166 cases have been disclosed in paragraph 16 of the affidavit, in 69 of which the applicant has been granted bail.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. In the affidavit filed in support of the application, it has been stated that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the present case.
5. It has been submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is languishing in jail since 16.07.2020 but trial of any of the cases has not commenced till date.
6. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.

7. Co-accused Manju Kaushal, Anjani Kumar Kaushal, Kanhaiya Lal Gupta @ Kanhaiya Kaushal,
Ajeet Kumar Gupta @ Ajeet Gupta have already been granted bail by means of orders dated 17.08.2023, 27.07.2023, 20.10.2022 & 06.02.2024 passed by this Court in Crl. Misc. Bail Application Nos. 5900 of 2022, 9441 of 2023, 12144 of 2022 & 688 of 2024.

entities.text: Crl. Misc. Bail Application Nos. 5900 of 2022, 9441 of 2023, 12144 of 2022 & 688 of 2024
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: 8. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the applicant is languishing in jail since 16.07.2020 for past more than 3 years & 9 months without even commencement of trial, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail in the present case.
9. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.

10. Let the applicant-Ajeet Kumar Gupta @ Ajeet Gupta be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of magistrate/court concerned, subject to following conditions:-
(i) the applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence;
(ii) the applicant shall not pressurize the prosecution witnesses;
(iii) the applicant shall appear on each and every date fixed by the trial court.
Order Date :- 16.4.2024 Pradeep/-
